name: Mailbox
description: Load the headers of all your mail (sender, recipients, subject, date, flags, size) from the IMAP accounts you add, with totals and the latest messages in one panel. Starts a helper process with Orca's own Node that connects to the mail servers you add and keeps a copy of those headers on this computer. Passwords are typed in your browser and kept in Orca's secrets. Read-only: it never moves, flags or deletes mail.

commands.title: Mailbox: Apply the last panel action
